run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded run - outbound HTTPS via the WebFetch tool was again entirely blocked by the environment egress policy (blanket block re-confirmed: example.com AND www.tenders.gov.au both returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, and the agent proxy status endpoint reported recentRelayFailures: [] - an organisation-level egress restriction, not a per-site fault; per /root/.ccr/README.md such policy denials are reported, not routed around). Only the WebSearch tool was functional. WebSearch surfaced genuine, currently-relevant buyer-originated opportunities and portals across Tier 1 (AusTender ATMs, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, Tenders WA, SA Tenders and Contracts, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT), Tier 2 (VendorPanel public tenders, University of Sydney via its own TenderLink portal, University of Wollongong, Sydney Water / Melbourne Water GBEs) and Tier 3 (SAP Business Network Discovery, EstimateOne - both registration/login-gated). Because no tender detail page or specification document could be opened via WebFetch, every tender below is captured at HEADLINE level only: deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, exact values and contacts are UNVERIFIED and left null/empty unless a fact appeared directly in a buyer-originated search snippet. The best-verified item this run is the Commonwealth GovCMS Drupal & DXP Services Panel (FIN-2026-27-GovCMS), for which the AusTender publish date (12-Aug-2026), closing date (7-Oct-2026) and contract term were readable from search snippets. Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing hubs were checked and remain entirely registration/login-gated: no publicly-visible corporate RFx detail was accessible, so no corporate tenders were invented; those portals are recorded in discovered_sources with access_method=portal-registration. Source discovery still ran and found two genuinely new buyer-originated council sources not already in the known set (City of Canada Bay NSW, Eurobodalla Shire Council NSW).
gaps: WebFetch / outbound HTTPS is entirely blocked by the environment egress policy (EGRESS_BLOCKED on every host tested this run, including example.com and www.tenders.gov.au; agent proxy status reported no recent relay failures). No tender detail page or specification document could be opened, so all deliverables/requirements/evaluation/value/contact fields are null and every tender is headline-level only. This has now recurred across multiple consecutive daily runs and blocks the deliverables-extraction half of the routine.

Tier 1 core portals (AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, Tenders WA, SA Tenders and Contracts, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) could only be searched via WebSearch, not fetched. Concrete open-tender rows with verified IDs/closing times for VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS and ACT were not retrievable at row level from search snippets this run and are deferred to a future run when egress is available.
A 'Tenders SA' / 'Buying4SA' query was polluted by South-Africa results (SA ambiguity); no South Australian open tender could be confirmed at row level this run.

AusTender ATMs RASS (PR10031930-RASS) and PRN9254 (Outreach Program Counsellors panel) were surfaced with structured Atm/Show deep links but their closing dates were not fully readable from snippets; RASS services commence 1-Sep-2026 and PRN9254 is a future/market notice (RFT planned for release on AusTender in Sep-2026), captured accordingly.

University of Wollongong ServiceNow EOIs (closing 04-Sep-2026) were surfaced only via the aggregator australiantenders.com.au; used as a discovery signal, captured against the UOW buyer, but the buyer's own detail-page deep link could not be confirmed because WebFetch egress was blocked.

Power and Water Corporation (NT GBE) tender closing 23-Sep-2026 14:00 ACST surfaced via QTOL search but its title was not in the snippet and the detail page (tendersonline.nt.gov.au) is login-gated; recorded at headline level with title pending.

Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing hubs (SAP Business Network Discovery / Ariba, EstimateOne construction subcontractor packages, RangeMe, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue supplier portals) are registration- or login-gated; no publicly-visible RFx detail was accessible. Portals recorded in discovered_sources; no corporate opportunities fabricated.

Invitation-only management-consultancy and panel RFPs, and the DFAT Development Procurement Pipeline (released only to shortlisted organisations), are out of scope - not publicly discoverable and not recorded as tenders.
